name: artifact-format-eval
description: Benchmark harness for comparing agent artifact formats across controlled coverage fixtures.

scripts.test: ARTIFACT_EVAL_RUNTIME=jsdom node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/fixture/*.test.ts tests/security/*.test.ts
scripts.notebook:build: uv run python -m artifact_eval_notebook build --case prior-auth
scripts.verify: pnpm validate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && uv run pytest && pnpm benchmark && uv run python -m artifact_eval_notebook validate results/prior-auth/baseline/artifact.ipynb && pnpm doctor --ci && pnpm test:playwright
